newsitem.title: UK: Redland tumbles as H1 profit disappoints.
newsitem.headline: Redland tumbles as H1 profit disappoints.

text.p: Shares in UK building materials group Redland Plc tumbled over two percent on Thursday after the company released first-half results at the lower end of analysts' forecasts.
Redland shares were down nine pence at 435-1/2p by 0722 GMT, while the overall market was indicated steady.

Redland said pretax profits dropped to 95 million stg in the first half of this year from 165.2 million a year earlier. Analysts had forecast pretax profits between 86 million stg and 130 million stg.
Other firms in the sector were indicated slightly lower.
